audit.whatIsWrong: The page rates the lane EVEN 5.5/10 while this packet reports a 33.33% Neeko win rate over 33 games, and the already-audited mirror (karma__neeko) rates the same lane HARD for Karma off a 37.04% Karma win rate.
audit.why: Both packets show the same lane as losing for their own side, so the two data sources disagree and I cannot verify which is right. Mechanically Tangle-Barbs (E, 1000) out-ranges Karma's only lockdown, Focused Resolve (W, 675), and Karma has no dash — that supports the mirror's Neeko-favoured reading, but not against a 33% sample.
audit.corrected: Left diff, diffRating and carryRating untouched and raised the contradiction in questionsForUser rather than assert a direction I cannot verify.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart read Skill at levels 1, 2, 3, 4-5, first item and 2+ items, disagreeing with the packet chart and with the mirror page, which already ships Karma at level 2 and Neeko at 3, 4-5, first item and 2+.
audit.why: The mirror is on disk and mirror-fix.js overwrites any disagreement, so the two directions must state the same rows. Level 2 is Karma's: Inner Flame (Q, 950) plus Gathering Fire's Mantra refunds chip faster than one Blooming Burst. From 3 onward Tangle-Barbs decides trades, and Pop Blossom at 6 makes the chain lethal.
audit.corrected: win[1]/phases[1].side to Karma; win[2], win[3], win[5], win[6] and their phases[N].side to Neeko, proposed as matched pairs, with ratings rescaled inverse to the mirror's.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer calls Karma's threat 'RQ (empowered Tangle root + tether)' and 'RQ (empowered Q root + tether)'. Mantra-Q (Inner Flame) is a delayed cataclysm with no root; the root and the heal are on Mantra-W, Focused Resolve.
audit.why: Riot's own text: Focused Resolve tethers, reveals and roots, and its Mantra bonus heals Karma and extends the root. Inner Flame's Mantra bonus only adds a delayed detonation. Naming the wrong spell sends the player dodging the wrong cast.
audit.corrected: spikes[3].text and wants.foe[1] now name Focused Resolve (W) at 675 range as her only lockdown, and state the Mantra-W heal.
sources: kit: Karma W text and range 675

audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal for this matchup: her sustain comes off Mantra-W, so anti-heal timing decides extended trades.

notes: The two packets disagree about who loses this lane (Neeko 33.33% here, Karma 37.04% on the mirror page). I followed the mirror for the level chart because mirror-fix.js enforces it, but left diff/diffRating/carryRating alone rather than assert EASY against a 33% win rate. The full layer calls Karma 'he/his' throughout (enemyWin, ahead, tradeGood, breakdown.wave, report[3].t) while the content layer says 'she' — a template-wide pronoun issue, not a matchup fact, so I left it rather than half-fix it. Also worth knowing: Tangle-Barbs grows larger, faster and roots longer after passing a champion, so Karma standing behind her wave does not shrink it.
